Rashi on Pesachim 49a:10:1.hebrew: אני לא שמעתי - שתהא מצוה אלא סעודת אירוסין לבדה, אבל לא סעודת סבלונות:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:10:1.english: I have not heard - that [there] is a mitzvah except [for] the betrothal feast alone, but not the feast of gifts.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:12:1.hebrew: בת כהן - צריכה להינשא לכהנים, ולא לפגום משפחתה להינשא לישראל:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:12:1.english: The daughter of a priest - She should marry priests, and not blemish her family [by] marrying an Israelite.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:12:2.english: Their union does not turn out well - [It does not succeed] with good fortune.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:13:1.english: What is it - What comes of them?

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:13:2.hebrew: או אלמנה או גרושה או זרע אין לה - כדכתיב (ויקרא כ״ב:י״ג) ובת כהן כי תהיה לאיש זר, וסמיך ליה ובת כהן כי תהיה אלמנה וגרושה וזרע אין לה וגו':
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:13:2.english: Either a widow, or a divorcee, or she has no offspring - As it is written (Leviticus 22:13): "And a priest's daughter, when she is [married] to an outsider [a non-priest]," and juxtaposed to it [is]: "And a priest's daughter, when she is a widow, or a divorcee, and she has no offspring, etc."

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:14:1.hebrew: תלמיד חכם - הוא שבח לו, אבל עם הארץ ואינו כהן — גנאי הוא לו לאהרן, ונענשים:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:14:1.english: A Torah scholar - He is an honor to him [Aaron], whereas an ignoramus who is not a priest is a disgrace to him, to Aaron, and they are punished.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:17:1.hebrew: לא גלאי - רב כהנא גלה מבבל לא"י, כדאמר בהגוזל ומאכיל (ב"ק קיז.):
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:17:1.english: I would not have been exiled - Rav Kahana was exiled from Babylonia to the Land of Israel, as it says in [the chapter entitled] HaGozel UMa'achil (Bava Kamma 117a).

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:17:2.hebrew: לא גלאי כדגלו אינשי - שאר תלמידים יוצאים מדעתן, ואני יצאתי על כרחי מחמת מרדין ואימת מלכות:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:17:2.english: I was not exiled as people are exiled - Other students go out of their own free will, whereas I went out against my will on account of rebels and fear of the government.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:19:1.hebrew: ומאלמן את אשתו - שמבקש לימודו ואי אפשר לו, וגולה למזונות, והרי אשתו באלמנות חיות:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:19:1.english: And he widows his wife - For he seeks his learning and it is impossible for him [to do so], and he goes into exile for sustenance, and behold, his wife is in living widowhood.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:19:3.english: And his learning is forgotten - For he is not engaged in reviewing it.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:19:4.hebrew: ומחלוקות רבות באות עליו - מחמת ששכח תלמודו, או הקפות שמקיף מחנונין לסעודותיו:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:19:4.english: And many disputes come upon him - Because he has forgotten his studies, or [because of] the credit that he takes from shopkeepers for his feasts.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:1:1.hebrew: מבערין את הכל - בין חולין בין תרומה, חוץ מכדי אכילתו לשבת. אבל כל מה שעתיד לבער, יבער:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:1:1.english: One removes everything - whether non-sacred [food] or teruma, except for enough for his eating on Shabbat; rather, whatever is destined to be removed, he must remove [before Shabbat].

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:1:2.hebrew: תרומה מלפני השבת - שאינו יכול להאכילה לא לזרים ולא לבהמת זרים, ולהשהותה אי אפשר. אבל חולין, אין צריך לבער אלא בזמנו, שיכול למצוא להן אוכלים הרבה:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:1:2.english: Teruma before Shabbat - For he cannot feed it either to non-priests or to the animals of non-priests, and it is impossible to keep it. However, [as for] non-sacred [food], he need only remove [it] at its [usual] time, for he can find many people to eat it.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:20:1.english: They call him - [That is,] his son.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:20:2.english: [Who] dances in taverns - In the manner of jesters who perform and dance in taverns in order to be given drink as their payment.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:20:4.hebrew: מך רבע - מקפל לבושו ורובץ וישן. דרך המשתכרין: אינו מספיק לילך לביתו ולשכב על מטתו, אלא מקפל לבושו תחתיו וישן:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:20:4.english: Folds [his garment] and crouches - He folds his garment, crouches, and sleeps. [This is] the way of those who get drunk: he does not manage to go to his house and lie down on his bed; rather, he folds his garment beneath himself and sleeps.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:20:5.english: Makh [lowers/lays down] - Like [the expression], "Ass-driver, lower your sack and sleep" (Taanit 6b).

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:2:1.english: Spent Shabbat - He stayed there one Shabbat.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:3:1.english: One who is traveling - On the fourteenth [of Nisan].

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:3:2.english: If he is able - [Meaning] that there is [sufficient] time in the day.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:4:1.english: To save from the gentiles - [To save] Jews who are being pursued.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:4:2.hebrew: יבטל בלבו - ולא יחזור, ואפי' יש שהות, דמדאוריי' סגי ליה בביטול בעלמא:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:4:2.english: He should nullify [it] in his heart - And he should not return, even if there is [sufficient] time, for by Torah law mere nullification suffices for him.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:4:3.hebrew: לשבות שביתת הרשות - שהיה הולך להחשיך על התחום לקנות שביתה שם, כדי שיהא לו משם ולהלן אלפים לילך למחר שם לדבר הרשות — יחזור מיד. אבל לקנות שביתת מצוה, כגון שילך מחר חוץ לתחום לבית האבל או לבית המשתה, היינו כהולך לשחוט את פסחו:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:4:3.english: To establish an optional Shabbat residence - [Meaning] that he was going to stay until nightfall at the [Shabbat] boundary to acquire a [Shabbat] residence there, so that he would have two thousand [cubits] from there onward to go there the next day for an optional matter — he must return immediately. However, [if he went] to acquire a Shabbat residence for a mitzvah, such as where he will go the next day beyond the boundary to a house of mourning or to a house of feasting, that is like one who goes to slaughter his Passover offering.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:5:1.hebrew: שיש בידו בשר קודש - עמו בדרך, ונפסל ביוצא, שמחיצת קדשים קלים חומת ירושלים:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:5:1.english: That there was consecrated meat in his hand - [With] him on the road, and it became disqualified by leaving [its boundary], for the boundary of offerings of lesser sanctity is the wall of Jerusalem.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:5:2.english: If he passed Tzofim - [It is] the name of a village from which one can see the Temple.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:5:3.english: He burns it in his place - And they did not trouble him to return.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:5:4.hebrew: ואם לאו חוזר ושורפו כו' - כדאמרן בכל שעה (לעיל פסחים כד.), "בקודש באש תשרף", דבמקום אכילתו שריפתו:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:5:4.english: And if not, he returns and burns it, etc. - As we said in [the chapter] Kol Sha'ah (above, Pesachim 24a): "In the holy [place] it shall be burned with fire," for its burning is in the place of its eating.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:6:1.hebrew: זה וזה - חמץ דאמרן לעיל, ונזכר שיש לו חמץ בביתו, ובשר קודש שעמו:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:6:1.english: This and that - [Referring to] the leavened bread that we mentioned above, [when] he remembered that he has leavened bread in his house, and [to the] consecrated meat that is with him.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:6:2.hebrew: בכביצה - אבל בפחות, גבי חמץ יבטל בלבו, וגבי בשר קודש שורפו במקומו:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:6:2.english: An egg-bulk - But for less [than that]: regarding leaven, he nullifies [it] in his heart; and regarding consecrated meat, he burns it in its place.

Rashi on Pesachim 49a:9:1.hebrew: סעודה שניה - כך הוא דרך החתנים: לאחר סעודת אירוסין, חוזר ומשגר סבלונות לארוסתו וסועד שם:
Rashi on Pesachim 49a:9:1.english: The second feast - Such is the custom of grooms: after the betrothal feast, [the groom] again sends gifts to his betrothed and dines there.

Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:10:1.hebrew: תניא א"ר יהודה - תימה, אמאי לא מייתי "תניא נמי הכי" מהך דהכא לרב חסדא:
Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:10:1.english: It was taught [in a baraita]: Rabbi Yehuda said - [This is] astonishing: why does [the Gemara] not cite "It was also taught thus" from this [baraita] here [in support of] Rav Chisda?

Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:17:1.hebrew: אמר רב כהנא אי לאו דנסיבי כהנתא לא גלאי - שמע שלא היה כהן. והא דאמרינן בפ"ק דקדושין (דף ח.): "רב כהנא שקל סודרא בפדיון הבן" — בשביל אשתו היה לוקח, כדאמרינן בפ' הזרוע (חולין דף קלב.): "רב כהנא הוה אכיל בשביל אשתו". והא דאמר בפרק ערבי פסחים (לקמן פסחים קיג.): "א"ל רב לרב כהנא: פשוט נבילתא בשוקא ושקול אגרא, ולא תימא כהנא [וגברא] רבא אנא" — לא בשביל שהיה כהן, אלא שכך היה שמו:
Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:17:1.english: Rav Kahana said: Had I not married a daughter of a priest, I would not have been exiled - From this it is inferred that he was not a priest. And [as for] that which we say in the first chapter of Kiddushin (8a), "Rav Kahana took a scarf for the redemption of the firstborn [son]" — he took [it] on account of his wife, as we say in chapter HaZeroa (Chullin 132a), "Rav Kahana would eat [priestly gifts] on account of his wife." And [as for] that which it says in chapter Arvei Pesachim (below, Pesachim 113a), "Rav said to Rav Kahana: Skin a carcass in the marketplace and take wages, and do not say, 'I am a priest [and] a great [man]'" — [this was] not because he was a priest, but rather because that was his name:

Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:4:1.hebrew: לשבות שביתת הרשות - פ"ה שהיה הולך להחשיך על התחום לקנות שביתה שם, ולילך ד' אלפים לדבר הרשות. וקשה: א"כ תיקשי למ"ד בפ' בכל מערבין (ערובין לא.) "אין מערבין אלא לדבר מצוה". ונר' לר"י דה"פ: "לשבות שביתת הרשות" — שהולך לשמוח בפסח בבית אוהבו או קרובו:
Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:4:1.english: To establish a Shabbat [residence for an] optional [purpose] - Rashi explained that he was going to stay until nightfall at the Shabbat boundary to acquire a Shabbat residence there and [thereby] walk four thousand [cubits] for an optional matter. And this is difficult: if so, it would pose a difficulty according to the one who says in the chapter [entitled] Bekhol Me'arvin (Eruvin 31a), "One may only make an eruv for a mitzvah matter." And it appears to Ri [Rabbeinu Yitzchak] that this is its explanation: "To establish a Shabbat [residence for an] optional [purpose]" — that he is going to rejoice on Passover at the house of his friend or his relative.

Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:5:1.hebrew: אם עבר צופים - פי' בקונט' שם כפר. וקשה לר"י: א"כ, ה"ל למימר "וכמדתו לכל רוח", כדתניא בפ' מי שהיה טמא (לקמן פסחים צג:): "איזהו דרך רחוקה? מן המודיעין ולחוץ, וכמדתה לכל רוח". ואור"י דבתוספתא דמכילתין מפרש בהדיא: "איזהו צופים? הרואה ואין מפסיק", פי': כל מקום סביב ירושלים שיכול לראותו משם:
Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:5:1.english: If he passed Tzofim - [Rashi] explained in the Kuntres [that it is] the name of a village. And this is difficult for the Ri: if so, [the Tanna] should have said "and a corresponding distance in every direction," as it is taught in a baraita in the chapter [entitled] Mi Shehayah Tamei (below, Pesachim 93b): "What is [considered] a distant journey? From Modi'in and beyond, and a corresponding distance in every direction." And the Ri says that in the Tosefta of our tractate it explains explicitly: "What is Tzofim? [Any place] that sees [it] and nothing intervenes," meaning: any place around Jerusalem from which one can see it.

Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:5:2.hebrew: ושורפו לפני הבירה - פ"ה כדאמר פ' כל שעה (פסחים דף כד.): "בקודש באש ישרף" — במקום אכילתו שריפתו. וקשה לר"י: אי דאורייתא הוא, מה לי עבר צופים ומ"ל לא עבר צופים? וי"ל דמן התורה יכול לשורפה בכ"מ שירצה, דבפרק כל שעה (ג"ז שם) לא מרבינן אלא פסולי קדשי קדשים ואימורי קדשים קלים, אבל שאר קדשים שנאכלים לזרים לא מרבינן. ומה שהצריכו חכמים לשרוף הני דהכא לפני הבירה — היינו גזירה אטו קדשי קדשים:
Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:5:2.english: And he burns it before the Temple [Birah] - The Rabbi [Rashi] explained [that this is] as it states in the chapter Kol Sha'ah (Pesachim 24a): "In the holy [place] it shall be burned with fire" — in the place of its eating is its burning. And it is difficult for R"i: If it is [a] biblical [requirement], what is [the difference] to me [whether] he passed Tzofim and what is [the difference] to me [whether] he did not pass Tzofim? And one can answer that by Torah law he may burn it wherever he wishes, for in the chapter Kol Sha'ah (ibid.) we only include disqualified most-holy offerings [kodshei kodashim] and the sacrificial parts of offerings of lesser holiness [kodashim kalim], whereas other consecrated [meats] that may be eaten by non-priests we do not include. And that which the Sages required [one] to burn these [offerings] here before the Temple [Birah] — that is a [rabbinic] decree on account of most-holy offerings.

Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:5:3.hebrew: לפני הבירה - בזבחים בפ' טבול יום (זבחים דף קד:) פליגי מאי בירה: אמר רבה בר בר חנה א"ר יוחנן: מקום יש בהר הבית ובירה שמו. ר"ל אמר: כל הבית כולו הוי בירה, שנאמר: "אל הבירה אשר הכינותי":
Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:5:3.english: Before the birah - In Zevachim, in the chapter [entitled] Tevul Yom (Zevachim 104b), they disagree [as to] what birah is. Rabbah bar bar Chanah said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan: There is a place on the Temple Mount, and Birah is its name. Reish Lakish says: The entire Temple is [called] birah, as it is stated: "to the birah which I have prepared."

Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:6:1.hebrew: וחכמים אומרים בשר קודש בכזית וחמץ בכביצה - אומר ריב"א דמפרש בירושלמי: משום דבשר קודש לית ליה תקנה בביטול, החמירו בכזית; אבל חמץ אית ליה תקנה בביטול, לא החמירו עד כביצה:
Tosafot on Pesachim 49a:6:1.english: And the Sages say: consecrated meat is [at the measure of] an olive-bulk, and leavened bread is [at the measure of] an egg-bulk - Riva [Rabbi Yitzchak ben Asher] says that it is explained in the Jerusalem Talmud: because consecrated meat has no remedy through nullification, they were stringent [and required returning] for an olive-bulk; whereas leavened bread has a remedy through nullification, [so] they were not stringent [to require returning] until [there is] an egg-bulk.
